retrievalProfile.description: A vertical split-screen composition featuring a high-contrast black textured panel with oversized neon typography and a clean studio portrait in cool lighting.
excludeWhen: a single full-frame image is required
warm or vintage color palettes are requested
serif or decorative script typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic layout divided vertically: the left side is a dark, textured charcoal field containing large-scale neon green display text and a small tracklist; the right side is a clean studio portrait of a subject against a pale lavender-blue background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between textured dark space and smooth light space
Aggressive neon green typography against a matte black background
Subject's dark leather texture echoing the dark graphic panel
Tight, justified text blocks contrasting with large, airy negative space
coreInvariants: Neon green #CCFF00 or similar high-visibility lime
Vertical split approximately at the 40% mark
Subject wearing dark, textured clothing to bridge the two panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right 60% of the frame, three-quarter length, medium-close shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized display title in the top left corner acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left title, down the tracklist, across to the subject's face, and down to the bottom-left branding block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant breathing room around the subject and within the dark left panel to emphasize the text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Lime Green (Typography and UI elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black panel and light backdrop; high saturation contrast between the neon text and neutral surroundings.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the title overlaps the boundary between the black and light panels.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic color pairing with high scale contrast between display and body text.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangle containers for bottom metadata
Subtle grain texture on the black panel

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric, and heavy impact of the title.
Provides the necessary legibility for the small tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split-screen image. The left 40% is a textured matte black surface. The right 60% is a studio portrait of a person in a black leather jacket against a solid pale lavender-blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add oversized neon green sans-serif text in the top left, stacked. Add a small list of text in the same neon green below it. Add two rounded-corner boxes at the bottom left containing metadata.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear vertical split between black and lavender?
Does the title text overlap the image slightly?
Is the tracklist text small and left-aligned?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles
Unique logo shapes in the bottom corner

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the black panel

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'S' or last letter of the title overlaps the image panel.
Ensure the neon green is vibrant and not muddy.
Verify the vertical split is sharp and straight.
Confirm the tracklist is legible despite its small size.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Split (40/60) + Matte Black Texture + Pale Studio Backdrop + Neon Geometric Sans Overlay
